summary: Loads a compiled C++ plugin for custom TOP behavior, including custom parameters, multiple output buffers, CPU memory, and CUDA output paths.

key_params.name: unloadplugin
key_params.note: Unload plugin so the file can be replaced

key_params.name: depthbuffer
key_params.note: Depth buffer mode: none, fixed24, or float32

common_gotchas: Unload every TOP using a plugin before replacing that plugin file on disk.
Python support works for Custom Operators, not inside a normal CPlusPlus TOP node.
CUDA operations must be bracketed with the documented begin/end calls.
Printing from plugin code can significantly hurt performance.
key_concepts: CPlusPlus TOP loads a compiled plugin that implements custom TOP behavior.
Each CPlusPlus TOP owns one plugin class instance.
Plugins can expose custom parameters and Info CHOP/DAT output.
The TOP can output multiple color buffers when the plugin supports them.
CUDA plugin workflows use documented beginCUDAOperations and endCUDAOperations lifecycle calls.
Plugins compiled against older pre-2022 OpenGL-era headers may need Vulkan-era upgrades.
